section_summary.extract_value: This conclusion section summarizes the findings of a single study, noting that the final model, which investigated interpersonal and intrapersonal links to body appreciation and its connection to intuitive eating, fit well with college women. Body appreciation was found to play a central mediational role, linking interpersonal (restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages, attachment anxiety) and intrapersonal (discrepancy perfectionism) variables to intuitive eating. The study also found that body appreciation did not predict unique variance in depressive symptoms, suggesting it is distinct from negative body image, and recommends exploring similar models with diverse samples.
